text.en:
1. This Act may be cited as the Synod of the Diocese of
West Malaysia (Incorporation) Act, 1971.

2. (J) The Synod of the Diocese of West Malaysia, and
its successors shall be a body corporate and shall have
perpetual succession under the name "The Synod of the
Diocese of West Malaysia" hereinafter called the Corpora-
tion and shall be the governing body of the Anglican
Church in West Malaysia.

(2) The Corporation may enter into contracts, and may
acquire, purchase, take, hold and enjoy movable and
immovable property of every description and may convey,
transfer, assign, surrender and yield up, charge, mortgage,
demise, reassign or otherwise dispose of, or deal with, any
movable or immovable property vested in the Corporation
and may lend or borrow money upon such terms as to the
Standing Committee of the Corporation, hereafter referred
to as the Standing Committee, may seem fit, and the minutes
of the Standing Committee shall be sufficient evidence of
such terms.

(3) The Corporation may sue and be sued in respect of
its property and otherwise in all courts of justice and in all
matters and suits.

3. (1) The Corporation shall have a common seal, and such
seal may from time to time be broken, changed, altered
and made anew as to the Standing Committee seems fit.

(2) The seal of the Corporation shall not be affixed to
any deed document or other instrument except by authority
of a resolution of the Standing Committee and in the
presence of two members of the Standing Committee one

(3) All deeds documents and other instruments requiring
the seal of the Corporation shall be sealed with the seal of
the Corporation and shall also be signed by the two
witnesses referred to in sub-section (2).

(4) Such signing shall be sufficient evidence that the said
seal was duly and properly affixed and that the said seal is
the lawful seal of the Corporation.

4. (1) The Secretary of the Synod of the Diocese of
Singapore as incorporated under the Synod of the Diocese
of Singapore Ordinance, 1958 in whom is vested all movable
and immovable property situated in West Malaysia belong-
ing to the Corporation immediately before the commence-
ment of this Act is hereby divested of all such movable and
amevabls  property and all estates rights and interests
therein

(2) All movable and immovable property referred to in
subsection (1) and all estates rights and interests therein
are hereby vested in the Corporation for the respective
estates rights and interests for which the same are held and
the Corporation shall have full power to deal with the said
property as provided in subsection (2) of section 2.

(3) The appropriate Collector of Land Revenue or
Registrar of Titles as the case may be shall substitute the
name of the Corporation in place of that of the registered
holder in the case of any registered interest in immovable
property in West Malaysia formerly vested in the Secretary
of the Synod of the Diocese of Singapore.

5. The Synod of the Diocese of Singapore Ordinance, 1958
is hereby repealed.
